project.name: e3mu-neo-stress-coupling
project.system: multi-source periodic materials with electric and spin response

user_preferences.route: public DFT label recovery plus conservative MLIP coupling and a deferred paired-spin VASP lane
user_preferences.depth: validated dataset and launch-ready reference scaffold
constraints: no 3D Cauchy stress for partially periodic systems
do not launch VASP without licensed POTCAR and a pilot gate
accepted_alternatives: retain w_magnetoelastic=0 until paired labels exist
use MPtrj magnetic stress only as total spin-conditioned stress

research_spine.objective: Build non-OMat24 stress coverage for Neo Tiny-Large and connect strain response explicitly to L2 electric and L3 spin physics.
research_spine.current_gate: Obtain licensed POTCAR provenance and resource approval for a bounded constrained-spin VASP convergence pilot.
research_spine.next_action: Run only the bounded constraint-lambda/cutoff/k-point pilot after those prerequisites are documented; do not launch the 1,080-job campaign.
research_spine.stop_rule: Keep w_magnetoelastic=0 and make no L3 differential-stress accuracy claim until same-geometry, same-method spin pairs pass DFT convergence and grouped holdout gates.

scale_decision.rationale: Stress, piezoelectric response, and magnetoelastic response are resolved by periodic DFT labels and derivatives of the atomistic generalized energy.
scale_decision.escalation_trigger: Add extended dynamics or continuum only after a validated stress-trained checkpoint and a downstream observable require those scales.

claims.text: One coupled scalar energy yields conservative total and component stress, L2 piezoelectric response, and paired L3 magnetoelastic stress.
claims.observable: finite-difference error, stress component closure, symmetry, and time-reversal invariance
claims.pass_condition: CPU float64 tests pass within declared tolerances and higher-derivative losses backpropagate finite gradients

claims.text: MPtrj and JARVIS provide non-OMat24 mechanism-matched stress coverage for Neo Tiny-Large.
claims.observable: validated source-specific counts for stress, stress+BEC+piezoelectric, and stress+spins
claims.pass_condition: all four tiers validate with finite symmetric tensors, provenance, response-family split isolation, and nonzero L1/L2/L3 total-stress coverage

claims.text: Same-geometry constrained-spin DFT pairs can identify differential L3 magnetoelastic response.
claims.observable: target-minus-reference DFT stress under systematic strain
claims.pass_condition: constraint/convergence pilot passes and grouped held-out magnetoelastic error meets a predeclared target

stages.name: source and convention audit
inputs: public raw archives and local canonical shards
outputs: source policy and tensor conversion contract
stages.pass_condition: Every accepted source has an unambiguous periodicity, unit, sign, method, and provenance contract.

stages.name: conservative stress and response implementation
stages.pass_condition: Finite-difference, invariance, component-closure, and backward tests pass.

stages.name: raw stress and DFPT enrichment
stages.pass_condition: Every selected source sample is matched and each converted shard passes strict validation.

stages.name: Tiny-Large tier rebuild and audit
stages.pass_condition: All four tiers validate and report nonzero L1, matched L2, and spin-conditioned L3 stress coverage.

stages.name: paired spin-strain VASP references
outputs: paired energies, forces, stress, spins, and provenance
stages.pass_condition: The bounded pilot converges and demonstrates stable stress below the constraint-penalty threshold.

stages.name: stress-coupled training and challenge validation
stages.pass_condition: Grouped challenge metrics meet predeclared tolerances without degrading protected energy/force targets.
